parts.t: Queens Park is the crown of New Westminster — a heritage-designated neighbourhood of breathtaking Victorian and Edwardian mansions surrounding one of the region's finest urban parks. For buyers who value architectural history, community pride, and the grace of a bygone era, Queens Park is unmatched.
